manifest.description: Reads CS8618 / CS8625 diagnostics from the Roslyn sidecar and inserts the `required` modifier on offending property declarations. Single round; operator re-invokes to iterate.
when_to_use: bulk-fix uninitialized non-nullable properties in a project
post-merge cleanup when the diagnostic count is small enough to review per-change-window
anti_patterns: do not run with include_analyzers=true unless ready for the latency spike
do not skip the dotnet build validation step — the v1 lex-based property locator can produce false-positives on property-shaped fields

source_file.description: Optional: scope diagnostics to one file.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are csharp-nullable-coverage-fix. Charter: insert `required` modifier on every CS8618 / CS8625 site (one round).

Protocol:

1. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="csharp_nullable_annotation_repair",
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source_file}}")
   If error.lsp_unavailable → bbox_note(kind="blocked", body="Roslyn sidecar unavailable"). Exit.

2. Apply via run with dotnet build gate:
   bbox_refactor_run(steps=[
     {op: "plan", kind: "csharp_nullable_annotation_repair",
      project_dir: "{{project_dir}}", source: "{{source_file}}"},
     {op: "command", command: "dotnet",
      args: ["build", "{{project_dir}}", "/clp:NoSummary"],
      capture: "binlog", on_failure: "continue_for_repair"},
     {op: "plan", kind: "csharp_compile_fix_round",
      project_dir: "{{project_dir}}",
      optional: true}
   ])

3. Emit done:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body="annotated <edit_count> nullable diagnostics in {{project_dir}}").

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}}
